audit_status: PASS for bounded research computations; no new validated somatic, treatment, or antigen claim

public_catalog_validation.caution: Public record-wide worst consequence or clinical label cannot substitute for allele-specific consequence; no population absence proof of somatic status.

VCF_validation.scope: Single exported alleles within +/-70 bp were compared by exact extended haplotype; not arbitrary combinations of multiple VCF rows or a validated sensitivity assessment.

six_candidates.judgment: DNA support remains strong through 50-base flanks. RNA support is low: 4 paired names reduce to 2 endpoint signatures. C3>C2 local repeat. Exact rare public allele rs1773564282; constitutional versus somatic unresolved.

DNA and RNA exact alternate survive 30-base flanks (81 DNA / 10 RNA names); 10 RNA endpoint signatures. A3>A2. No exact public match returned by the bounded lookup, which does not establish novelty. Several RNA reads also cross a splice junction outside the variant window, supporting transcript alignment.

Strong DNA evidence and modest RNA evidence (4 names / 4 endpoint signatures). Exact alternate survives 50-base flanks in 38 DNA / 2 RNA names. No high-frequency nearby compensating allele identified within the examined reference window. Late conditional frameshift, not evidence of complete gene loss.

DNA insertion is strongly supported, including 43 exact 50-base-flank names. RNA support is limited to 3 names / 2 endpoint signatures; all retain exact 20-base flanks. RNA CIGAR insertion is shifted by one base in equivalent sequence, so raw-coordinate equality would undercount it. All RNA alternate reads have only 1-3 soft-clipped bases at distant read ends; this alone is not grounds to discard them. Wider RNA windows fail coverage, not sequence equivalence. A nearby chr16:3563597G>A is carried on the other observed local haplotype and conditionally encodes Ser447Leu, not the record-wide dbSNP worst consequence stop_gained. Reference versus alternate fraction based on a short window is not a complete haplotype description.

Strong DNA and best RNA-name support among these six (13 names; 8 endpoint signatures), with all 13 RNA names surviving 30-base exact flanks. Repeated endpoints caution against treating every name as an independent molecule. Exact rare public allele rs781761828; no common nearby compensating allele seen in the bounded read context.

C7>C6 homopolymer deletion, with 34 DNA / 5 RNA exact alternate names and 4 RNA endpoint signatures. All 5 RNA names survive 30-base flanks. Zero 50-base RNA calls result from nearby splice/coverage constraints and do not refute the event. Exact rare public haplotype rs572408453 independently verified after root resolved the initial failed lookup; inherited versus somatic and polymerase slippage remain considerations.

necessary_interpretive_conditions: Paired read names and endpoint signatures are not UMI molecule counts. RNA BAM does not mark PCR duplicates.
Each reconstructed mutant sequence assumes the selected GENCODE37 transcript and only the tested allele, not a proven full-length expressed haplotype or protein.
Tumor-only DNA plus bulk RNA cannot establish somatic origin or prove expression in tumor cells; matched normal is decisive before any vaccine promotion.
No six-candidate result supports selecting a cancer drug or assigning lineage.
VCF absence is an export-scope observation, not evidence that Caris missed a clinically meaningful mutation.
FILTER dot means unfiltered/unspecified in standard VCF semantics, not an explicit PASS; CHD2 has an explicit R8.1 repeat filter.
